messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["fox", "barn owl"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A standing four-legged creature shown in left side profile with the overall shape, head, ears, legs, paws and long bushy tail of a red fox, but with owl-like plumage and wings. The head, legs and tail are covered in reddish-orange to brown fox fur, the neck, chest and upper back are covered in white to tan and grey speckled feather-like plumage, and a pair of folded feathered wings with tan, cream, grey and black markings lies along the sides of the mid-back.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "a red fox head with orange-red fur, white muzzle and lower cheek, black nose and amber eyes", "part": "head", "where": "at the front top of the body facing left in profile"}, {"looks_like": "tall pointed fox ears with tan-orange fronts, pale inner fur and dark rear edges", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head, held upright"}, {"looks_like": "slender fox legs covered in reddish-brown fur darkening toward the lower front", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two straight front legs and two bent hind legs"}, {"looks_like": "fox paws with rounded toes and short dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom ends of the legs resting on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "a long bushy fox tail with reddish-brown fur and a pale cream tip", "part": "tail", "where": "extending from the rear of the body back and down to the ground on the right"}, {"looks_like": "folded barn owl wings with layered tan, cream, grey and black-barred flight feathers", "part": "wings", "where": "along the sides of the mid-back, one large wing visible on the near side and a small white edge visible on the far side of the chest"}, {"looks_like": "soft barn-owl-like plumage, white on the chest and mottled tan and grey on the neck and back", "part": "feathers", "where": "covering the neck, chest, and upper back around the base of the wings"}, {"looks_like": "small black speckles and teardrop spots", "part": "markings", "where": "scattered over the white chest and neck and over the tan and grey wing coverts"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 2}
